chunks: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a woman praying near a man, and he said: 'The woman should not pray opposite the man unless there is something in front of her, even if it is the width of his chest.'
ai.seo_question: Where should a woman stand relative to a man during prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the spatial arrangement for congregational prayer, specifying that a woman praying behind a man must maintain a lateral offset equivalent to the width of his chest to ensure proper alignment and modesty. This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining the validity of the woman's prayer position relative to the male imam, emphasizing geometric precision in worship.
